name: @hypaware/codex
description: OpenAI Codex client adapter for HypAware, covering both the Codex CLI and Codex Desktop (they share ~/.codex/config.toml and ~/.codex/sessions). Registers the OpenAI-compatible upstream preset on the local AI gateway, configures Codex's config.toml to route through the gateway, and ships the hypaware-query, hypaware-reference, and hypaware-privacy skills.
